title: Brangwyn's Reference
content: For one of his murals,Frank Brangwyn(1867-1956) went to the trouble of posing models and setting up a grid to transfer the drawing.Frank Brangwyn, photo reference and detail from his muralfor the entrance of Olham Press in LondonBut he still changed what was in the reference to make it please him as a decorative design. Note the way the fingers of the right hand arch outward, and the way he completely invented the drapery.Do you like the changes he made? Did he overdo it, or did he achieve a pleasing geometry?Frank Brangwyn, lunette mural, 1936for the entrance of Olham Press (now demolished)For context, here's the entire lunette mural, so that you can see how the pose fits into the decorative effect (Courtesy Victorian WebandLISS Fine Arts).
